title: Use and sale of coordinated pricing algorithms prohibited
requirement: It is unlawful to sell, license, or provide coordinated pricing algorithms to landlords, or for landlords to use such algorithms to set or recommend rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in Berkeley.
coverage_conditions: residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley
exemptions: Products or processes that generate aggregated and anonymous rental data reports without recommending rent prices or fees, products used to establish rent or income limits for affordable housing guidelines, and information used for market research for project financing, appraisals, or software development research/testing/training.
quoted_span: It shall be unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide to City of Berkeley landlords any coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
